name: Mango Achar
description: A classic North Indian mango pickle made with raw mangoes, mustard oil, and a special blend of spices. Aged for weeks to develop deep, complex flavors that complement any meal.

name: Lemon Pickle
description: Tangy and spicy lemon pickle prepared using traditional methods with fresh lemons, red chili, and fenugreek seeds. A perfect condiment that enhances the flavor of dal and rice.

name: Garlic Pickle
description: Pungent and flavorful garlic pickle slow-cooked in mustard oil with aromatic spices. Each clove absorbs the rich masala for an intense, addictive taste that garlic lovers adore.

name: Mixed Vegetable Pickle
description: A medley of seasonal vegetables including carrot, cauliflower, turnip, and raw mango pickled together in a rich, spiced mustard oil base. A wholesome and colorful pickle bursting with variety.

name: Green Chili Pickle
description: Fiery green chili pickle for those who love the heat! Made with plump green chilies stuffed with mustard and fennel seeds then marinated in tangy lemon juice and spiced oil.

name: Carrot Pickle
description: Crunchy and mildly spiced carrot pickle that is light on the palate yet packed with flavor. Made from fresh red carrots with a hint of vinegar and turmeric for a beautiful golden hue.

name: Amla Pickle
description: Indian gooseberry pickle rich in Vitamin C and antioxidants. The amla is pickled with asafoetida, turmeric, and mustard seeds creating a unique tangy-bitter taste that is both healthy and delicious.

name: Gongura Pickle
description: A beloved Andhra specialty made from sorrel leaves (gongura) with a characteristic sour and spicy flavor. This pickle pairs beautifully with steamed rice, pappu, and pesarattu.

name: Bitter Gourd Pickle
description: A unique and acquired taste - bitter gourd pickle balances the bitterness of karela with bold spices and mustard oil. Known for its digestive benefits and distinct flavor profile.

name: Tomato Pickle
description: A South Indian style tomato pickle with ripe tomatoes cooked down with tamarind, red chilies, and tempered with mustard seeds. A versatile condiment that goes well with dosa and idli.

name: Raw Mango Pickle
description: Chunky raw mango pieces marinated in a vibrant red chili-mustard masala with the perfect balance of tangy and spicy. A summer special that brings the taste of grandmother's kitchen.

name: Maharashtrian Methamba
description: A traditional Maharashtra sweet-sour mango relish made with raw mango, jaggery, and fenugreek seeds. This classic Marathi preparation has a unique bittersweet taste and is a staple in Maharashtrian households.
